what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Uganda in Kenya: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3417 Ugandan asylum seekers in Kenya, 30.0% of all asylum seekers from Uganda.
Refugees from Uganda, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda in periods from 1995 to 2017, with the LRA and ADF among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Uganda in 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 61 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 and 2020 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Kenya.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Kenya only.
